text:
No hiring option can be put forward from this run.

- The £400k/year salary limit could not be checked in this model, so the comparison does not establish whether any option meets it.
- The result is fragile: small changes to assumptions could change the ordering, and every substantive input is an Olumi estimate rather than user-provided evidence.
- Platform delivery capacity is the most influential modelled assumption; annual salary spend also matters. The model further assumed that a higher Q3-shipping goal value is better, rather than having that objective explicitly stated.

This is a provisional comparison to argue with, not a decision answer.
